picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5M NIA grant extends UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham's flagship AI center for aging and Alzheimer's care — the largest funding commitment of the week and a vote of confidence in AI's role in connected healthcare for older adults.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: Harvard's Belfer Center 'pre-mortem' on catastrophic AI risk, citing real incidents like rogue-agent breaches and OpenAI's training pause, pushes AI safety from abstract worry to urgent policy agenda.
picks.title: Is it already too late to reduce catastrophic AI risk? — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: A joint MIT/CMU/NYU/Stanford team built an AI that beat top human players at Stratego, a landmark for imperfect-information game AI and a signal of progress on reasoning under hidden information.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego

picks.editorial_note: An AI-enabled biochip from the American University in Cairo offers rapid, low-cost pre-screening for cancers and other diseases, a potentially high-impact tool for under-resourced health systems.
picks.title: AI-enabled biochip for rapid cancer, disease detection | The American University in Cairo

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern researchers show a new class of AI models can spot precancerous colon lesions invisible to the human eye, a concrete step toward catching cancer earlier.
picks.title: AI is helping pathologists find harmful lesions the eye can’t see

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's machine learning tool estimates past radiation exposure from a routine blood test, a practical advance for biodefense and medical triage that bypasses specialized equipment.
picks.title: A Simple Blood Test Could Reveal Hidden Radiation Exposure

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's $8 million in federal grants to expand AI education and workforce training reflects growing government investment in building the AI-skilled workforce.
picks.title: UCR receives $8 million in federal grants

picks.editorial_note: A new CRADA between Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory pairs space-based computing with AI weather modeling, an early but strategically important industry-government research tie-up.
picks.title: Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory announce research collaboration on space-based weather modeling

picks.editorial_note: SDSU's binational shipbuilding research with Samsung Heavy Industries and South Korea's KEIT shows AI-driven manufacturing partnerships expanding into traditionally non-tech industrial sectors.
picks.title: SDSU launches shipbuilding research projects with South Korea, Samsung Heavy Industries | News | SDSU

picks.editorial_note: Inria and French emergency responders are building an AI tool that analyzes voice during emergency calls to detect heart attacks, a novel application that could speed life-saving triage.
picks.title: Samu-Voice: Analyzing voice and speech to detect acute transmural myocardial infarctions
